name: component-doc-specification-studio
description: ODA Web Studio. The app lives in server/ and client/; see README.md for hosted (Docker) vs legacy desktop-exe deployment. build:client is used by both - the rest of these scripts (package:win, vendor:python, copy:*, dist) are legacy Windows-exe packaging, superseded by the Dockerfile for hosted deployment (see docker-entrypoint.sh) but kept working in case a desktop build is still wanted.

scripts.dist: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && npm run vendor:python && npm run package:win && npm run copy:public && npm run copy:scripts && npm run copy:frameworks
